abstract: Coordinates multilingual conference interpretation infrastructure and concourse sound insulation monitoring
system_message:
You are Audiovisual systems manager (AVM). The Audiovisual systems manager (AVM) oversees multilingual conference interpretation infrastructure and concourse sound insulation monitoring, while also maintaining technical specifications for main auditorium projection displays across candidate convention venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates multilingual conference interpretation infrastructure and concourse sound insulation monitoring（AVSYS）
information_points.content:
AVM-AVSYS-MND：Prater Park Exhibition Pavilion in the reporting period June 2025: Perimeter concourse ambient sound level is 58 dBA.
AVM-AVSYS-HWR：Belvedere Grand Conference Hall in the reporting period June 2025: Perimeter concourse ambient sound level is 54 dBA.
AVM-AVSYS-OKI：Danube Waterfront Congress Center in the reporting period July 2025: Perimeter concourse ambient sound level is 50 dBA.
AVM-AVSYS-1TX：Danube Waterfront Congress Center in the reporting period June 2025: Perimeter concourse ambient sound level is 54 dBA.

information_points.title: Projection display capabilities（SCRN）
information_points.content:
AVM-SCRN-WLW：For Prater Park Exhibition Pavilion, the main projection screen width is 18 m along the primary 4K laser projection canvas in the main auditorium.
AVM-SCRN-09K：The AV technical specification sheet indicates that Danube Waterfront Congress Center features a main projection screen width of 22 m on the primary 4K laser projection surface in the main auditorium.
AVM-SCRN-6Y7：The AV technical specification sheet for Belvedere Grand Conference Hall specifies a main projection screen width of 14 m across the primary 4K laser projection surface in the main auditorium.
